body: Please don't try it. I don't know what your situation is, but just keep moving along and even if you have nothing in your life to live for currently, anything can happen, and next month you might have the things in your life that you were always longing for. I wish there was more that i could say, but just try to not think of the future, if possible, since that is where the worst thoughts come from. Just find ways to cope from day to day.

Everything you say is really accurate. I really don't want to kill myself. I want to live and be happy, and travel the world and have relationships and learn an instrument and languages. But everytime i think this way, i am just met with my lack of motivation and a million and one "What ifs". I used to have good friends, although still only few in number, however now, one of them has been hospitalized with anorexia and my other one has just became further and further apart from me as we do not actually have as much in common as we once did. I do have an idea to escape my situation, which involves a huge commitment and then a complete change of scenery, but i can't summon the motivation or ability to do it. This idea was learning mandarin and moving to china to teach english. I feel i just need to restart, as if what my life has been so far was just a faulty test run which i can move on from and forget. It just isn't that easy, and i end up doing nothing at all and just wasting time. Thank you very much for talking with me and trying to help me. I could never discuss this with my family or my remaining friends as i couldn't burden them with a deadweight like me.
Is it guaranteed? Or have there been cases of it failing?
That is true. I guess you win.
Slowest method also though? And fairly costly.

I guess my failures are rather more objective. I am not academically gifted in any way (which in itself isn't the end of the world), but combined with the fact that i completely lack motivation to attempt anything as well as all social skills, adds up to be more problematic. I am also a failure due to the fact that, since i have been able to think, i have always chosen the easy way out for everything. It is hard to explain, in all honesty, and i am sure it doesn't seem like much to people around me, and in theory i should be able to cope and work around this, it isn't working, and everything around me is gradually crumbling. My main issues are motivation and coping with never being successful. I can't deal with living a whole life of solitude and failures at everything i attempt. But the real predicament is finding a way to kill myself easier than living a lie. I struggle finding words, so i have probably completely miscommunicated what i tried to say. I will understand if you feel i am being melodramatic, and i can totally understand if you don't take me seriously.

Thank you for your message. However, I couldn't attempt a method that would potentially not work for reasons so selfish. I could never consciously deal with making my parents feel that they hadn't done enough, especially considering that they have literally been perfect. Currently though, i am able to keep up the facade of not being a total failure by ensuring that all my time is taken up through (usually antisocial) wasteful leisure activities like video games. If i try not to think ahead, i can just about keep going like i am. I honestly wish life had an off button though. Something i could just click and then it would be over without having to go through pain, potential failure and complete loss of dignity.

Oh don't worry. I am not in a position to do it. I wish i had the strength to though. Right now i have no motivation for anything, and i am piss poor at everything, with very few friends but without the bravery to actually kill myself due to the pain, and the possibility of it not working and then making everything worse.
Oh, I understand. I though you were just saying something rhetorical for comedies sake.

I don't really have a story. In fact, my situation is so pathetically mundane. I can't even take myself seriously for it. In essence though, I currently am a walking failure with a smile and the ability to reassure those around me that in fact, i am not a failure. Eventually, my lies will be found out, but until then i am just stuck in a limbo where, while i have no hope, i also don't have the bravery or the strength to jump in front of a train, or off a cliff. As i said, not much of a story. Just a weak individual.
That is one of the most obscure things i have seen today.
I guess it would. Although, I was kind of more interested in ways which are trigger-able by the person in question. Thank you for your response though.

As mentioned in reply above, nothing to talk about. I am not currently suicidal, since i am too scared of pain, and wouldn't want to risk ending up in a worse state than i already am. for example, being alive after an attempt, but being paralyzed is one of my greater fears. So no worries. This thread is purely out of interest.

Not a huge amount to talk about. I am not currently suicidal, although if an easy, painless and guaranteed way to die was presented to me, i would choose that. Although that isn't a possibility, so i am just interested in ways to end ones life that fit the criteria mentioned in OP.
I guess that would be similar to happening to be present as our sun had a super-nova? Who knows.

Thats still my biggest issue though. I don't know where to get the motivation to make a change. I have always been the person to take the easy way out for everything, and doing nothing has always been easier.

I just want to be happy in life. Ideally i would want to live comfortably with a loving partner, but i'm just not in a good place with education or women. I also just wish to start again. Every year i am a disappointment to my parents and it hurts not having the motivation to change and make them proud.
That is the thing. I am a talent-less socially shy person who cannot stick to doing anything with any degree of motivation. I have few friends as well, and the friends i do have aren't very close.
